+# Qwen3.5 Gated DeltaNet LoRA
+
+This note covers `patch_qwen35_hybrid_lora_specs` in
+`areal/engine/megatron_utils/megatron_bridge_patches.py`: why Gated DeltaNet `in_proj`
+is unfused, and why that unfuse still leaves one adapter on the concatenated mixer
+instead of four independent ones.
+
+## Why `in_proj` is unfused
+
+Stock AReaL Qwen3.5 LoRA already unfuses two projections: full-attention `linear_qkv`
+and MLP `linear_fc1`. The default target list is `linear_qkv`, `linear_proj`,
+`linear_fc1`, and `linear_fc2`. Gated DeltaNet layers do not have those names. They have
+one concatenated `in_proj` and an `out_proj`, and the original patch left `in_proj`
+fused with the input RMSNorm. A stock Qwen3.5 LoRA SFT run therefore freezes every
+DeltaNet mixer. That is most of a Qwen3.5 trunk.
+
+AReaL's `lora_targets_preset: all` (and `attn`) adds the mixer linears on a hybrid
+backbone: `in_proj` and `out_proj`. The `dense` preset is the same attention and MLP
+matrices, with the DeltaNet projections left out. `qv` does not touch them either.
+`PointerHead` is unrelated. It stays a dense linear and is never a LoRA target. Full
+fine-tuning does not need the unfuse either; the fused norm-plus-linear still trains.
+
+Hugging Face stores the mixer as five plain `nn.Linear`s (`in_proj_qkv`, `in_proj_z`,
+`in_proj_a`, `in_proj_b`, `out_proj`), and PEFT can wrap those names separately. A
+Hugging Face training forward still calls the four input projections separately.
+
+Megatron-Bridge builds the opposite graph. `get_gated_delta_net_module_spec` makes
+`in_proj` one fused LayerNorm-plus-linear (`fuse_input_layernorm: True`) whose weight is
+those four Hugging Face matrices concatenated. `GDNLinearMappingSeparate` in
+Megatron-Bridge is the load/save map between that one tensor and `in_proj_qkv` /
+`in_proj_z` / `in_proj_b` / `in_proj_a`. Megatron-Bridge LoRA adds the adapter to the
+normalized activation, and it reads that activation back from a fused linear that
+supports `return_layernorm_output`. MindSpeed's fused LayerNorm-plus-linear does not
+return it. That is the same reason `linear_qkv` and `linear_fc1` are already split into
+`PTNorm` plus `ColumnParallelLinear`. With `unfuse_gdn=True` the patch does that split
+for GDN `in_proj`, and it replaces `out_proj` with a plain `RowParallelLinear` so the
+LoRA wrapper will wrap it.
+
+## One `in_proj` adapter versus four mixer adapters
+
+The pointer-head plan (`qwen3.5_pointerhead_decision_training`) and
+`docs/qwen35-decision-head-plan.md` both stop at this unfuse. Their LoRA target list
+names the fused modules: `in_proj` and `out_proj`, one adapter each. Hugging Face PEFT
+can instead wrap `in_proj_qkv`, `in_proj_z`, `in_proj_b`, and `in_proj_a` as four
+independent rank-`r` adapters.
+
+Those four Hugging Face names are independent rank-`r` adapters. Each has its own
+down-projection. `out_proj` is one more, and that one already matches Megatron: both
+sides have a single output projection.
+
+After the unfuse, Megatron still has one `in_proj` adapter. Its down-projection is
+`r × hidden`, and its up-projection covers the concatenated rows `[q, k, v, z, b, a]`.
+The four slices share one rank-`r` bottleneck. Four independent adapters spend three
+extra down-projections (`3 × r × hidden`) so a qkv update cannot use up the rank that
+`z`, `b`, and `a` need. `b` and `a` are only `num_v_heads` rows, so a shared
+up-projection puts almost all of the rank into qkv. Those two small outputs are the
+mixer's beta and decay, so the missing rank is not a small slice of a big matrix.
+
+Megatron-Bridge's PEFT export does not remove the gap. `peft_bridge` slices the single
+up-projection into the four Hugging Face names and writes the same down-projection onto
+all four (`_split_gdn_in_proj_linear_out_weight` in
+`megatron/bridge/models/conversion/peft_bridge.py`). The saved file looks like four PEFT
+modules. The four `lora_A` tensors are copies of one matrix. A checkpoint trained with
+four independent down-projections is not the same object. Loading one layout into the
+other drops three of them. The split has to exist while the adapter is trained.
+
+`in_proj_qkv` itself stays one adapter. Hugging Face does not give q, k, and v separate
+mixer adapters. Splitting those three would be a second mismatch.
+
+The same pattern already exists for full attention and the MLP, and AReaL does not use
+the fix Megatron-Bridge ships for it. Plain `LoRA` puts one adapter on fused
+`linear_qkv` and one on fused `linear_fc1`. Hugging Face PEFT targets `q_proj`,
+`k_proj`, `v_proj` and `gate_proj`, `up_proj` separately. `CanonicalLoRA`
+(`megatron/bridge/peft/canonical_lora.py`) keeps those fused base GEMMs and adds
+separate adapters, then scatters the adapter outputs into Megatron's packed row order.
+AReaL's Megatron hook constructs plain `LoRA`, so Qwen3.5 attention and MLP LoRA have
+this same shared-rank gap. Matching the Hugging Face target set means using
+`CanonicalLoRA` for those projections and extending it for the mixer.
+
+## How to match four mixer adapters
+
+Keep the unfused `ColumnParallelLinear` as the frozen base GEMM. Leave
+`GDNLinearMappingSeparate` on that one weight. Add a wrapper in the style of
+`LoRALinearSplitQKV` / `LoRALinearSplitFC1UpGate`, used when `lora_targets_preset` is
+`all` or `attn`:
+
+- `in_proj_qkv`, `in_proj_z`, `in_proj_b`, `in_proj_a`: four `ParallelLinearAdapter`s on
+  the post-norm activation. `in_proj_qkv` is one adapter, with one down-projection,
+  covering q, k, and v together.
+- Pack the four outputs into the row order `GatedDeltaNet.forward` splits: local
+  `[q, k, v, z, b, a]`, then add that vector to the base `in_proj` output. The section
+  sizes are the ones in `merge_gdn_linear_weights`: `qk_dim`, `qk_dim`, `v_dim`,
+  `v_dim`, `num_v_heads`, `num_v_heads`, divided across tensor parallel.
+- `out_proj` stays a single `RowParallelLinear` adapter.
+- `dense` and `qv` do not build these four adapters.
+
+`z`, `b`, and `a` are each one contiguous block in both layouts, so a normal
+column-parallel adapter of those output sizes lands on the right rows. `in_proj_qkv`
+does not. Hugging Face stores it as flat `[Q; K; V]`. Megatron stores each
+tensor-parallel rank's rows as local q, then local k, then local v
+(`merge_gdn_linear_weights`). At tensor parallel 1 those orders are the same and a stock
+column-parallel adapter is enough. Above that, a contiguous shard of the flat matrix is
+a prefix of Q (or a span across Q and K), while the base linear owns a slice of every
+group. The qkv adapter's up-projection has to be row-sharded with that blocked layout,
+the same job `LoRALinearSplitQKV._interleave_qkv` does for attention. Sharing one
+down-projection across those q, k, and v blocks keeps it a single `in_proj_qkv` adapter.
+
+Splitting the base module into four `ColumnParallelLinear`s would also give four
+adapters, and it would change the GEMM, the tensor-parallel layout, and the weight
+bridge. The wrapper leaves the base forward and the checkpoint map alone.

+# Qwen3.5 PointerHead decision SFT
+
+Train a Qwen3.5 decision model (PointerHead readout + Gated DeltaNet LoRA) with AReaL on
+Ascend NPUs.
+
+## Single-NPU PoC
+
+Two epochs, LoRA rank 16, lr `5e-5`, `head_dim=256`. Give the script a local Qwen3.5
+checkpoint and your decision data. If you pass a suite directory it samples
+`n_per_source` records so you do not encode the full train split.
+
+Put this checkout first on `PYTHONPATH` if the image also has an `/AReaL` install. The
+launch script appends the node IP to `NO_PROXY` so local worker health checks are not
+sent through `HTTP_PROXY`.
+
+### Suite directory (sampled)
+
+A suite is a folder with `manifest.json` plus `train.jsonl` / `development.jsonl`.
+
+```bash
+cd /path/to/AReaL   # repo root
+
+export PYTHONPATH="$PWD${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
+export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
+
+MODEL_PATH=/path/to/Qwen3.5-4B-Base \
+SUITE_PATH=/path/to/decision-suite \
+  bash examples/decision/run_npu_poc.sh
+```
+
+### Already-sliced JSONL
+
+```bash
+MODEL_PATH=/path/to/Qwen3.5-4B-Base \
+TRAIN_PATH=/path/to/train.jsonl \
+VALID_PATH=/path/to/development.jsonl \
+  bash examples/decision/run_npu_poc.sh
+```
+
+### Unpacked command
+
+```bash
+export PYTHONPATH="$PWD${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
+export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
+
+python3 examples/decision/prepare_v7_sample.py \
+  --suite /path/to/decision-suite \
+  --out-dir examples/decision/data \
+  --n-per-source 32 --dev-per-source 4
+
+python3 examples/decision/train_decision.py \
+  --config examples/decision/qwen3_5_decision_sft_npu_poc.yaml \
+  scheduler.type=local \
+  cluster.n_gpus_per_node=1 \
+  actor.path=/path/to/Qwen3.5-4B-Base \
+  train_dataset.path=$PWD/examples/decision/data/poc-train.jsonl \
+  valid_dataset.path=$PWD/examples/decision/data/poc-dev.jsonl
+```
+
+A successful run finishes two epochs, logs `sft/decision_loss` trending down, writes
+LoRA adapters plus `head.pt`, and exits 0. Override `EPOCHS`, `STEPS`, `N_PER_SOURCE`,
+or `FILEROOT` on the shell script.
+
+## Pytest e2e
+
+The two-step NPU test skips unless you point it at local assets:
+
+```bash
+export PYTHONPATH="$PWD${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
+export DECISION_MODEL=/path/to/Qwen3.5-4B-Base
+export DECISION_SUITE=/path/to/decision-suite
+# or: export DECISION_TRAIN=/path/to/train.jsonl DECISION_VALID=/path/to/development.jsonl
+
+python3 -m pytest tests/test_qwen35_decision.py tests/test_qwen35_decision_e2e.py \
+  -q --tb=short
+```
+
+`test_qwen35_decision_e2e.py::test_qwen35_decision_sft_single_npu_poc` is marked `npu`
+and `slow`. It trains two steps, checks `decision_loss` is logged, and expects a
+`head.pt` checkpoint.
+
+## Parallelism
+
+`actor.backend` is a Megatron layout. The world size is `DP * TP * PP * CP * EP`, and on
+one node that equals `cluster.n_gpus_per_node`.
+
+| Layout                       | Backend                          | On Qwen3.5-4B-Base                                            |
+| ---------------------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| Data parallel (DP)           | `megatron:d2`, `megatron:d4`     | Replicates the model and splits the batch                     |
+| Tensor parallel (TP)         | `megatron:d1t2`, `megatron:d1t4` | Splits layers. Sizes 2 and 4 divide the 4 KV heads            |
+| Sequence parallel (SP)       | same backend as TP               | Turns on automatically when TP is greater than 1              |
+| Context parallel (CP)        | `megatron:d1c2`, `megatron:d1c4` | Splits each packed sequence across NPUs                       |
+| Pipeline parallel (PP) / VPP | `p` in the backend string        | Unsupported for this head. See below                          |
+| Expert parallel (EP)         | `e` in the backend string        | For MoE models. This 4B checkpoint is dense, so leave EP at 1 |
+| DP + TP                      | `megatron:d4p1t2`                | 8 NPUs, pipeline size 1. This is `qwen3_5_decision_sft.yaml`  |
+
+`examples/decision/run_npu_parallel.sh` maps the supported layouts to
+`PARALLEL=single|dp2|tp2|cp2|d4t2`. `tp2` is also the sequence-parallel example. A step
+cap writes a checkpoint and runs eval at the last step. Run one layout at a time on a
+single node so each local scheduler can bind its own ports.
+
+Single-NPU convergence on a small suite slice (about a few minutes after load):
+
+```bash
+MODEL_PATH=/path/to/Qwen3.5-4B-Base \
+SUITE_PATH=/path/to/decision-suite \
+N_PER_SOURCE=8 DEV_PER_SOURCE=2 EPOCHS=1 STEPS=24 \
+PARALLEL=single DEVICES=0 \
+  bash examples/decision/run_npu_parallel.sh
+```
+
+Two-step checks, one layout at a time:
+
+```bash
+MODEL_PATH=/path/to/Qwen3.5-4B-Base \
+SUITE_PATH=/path/to/decision-suite \
+N_PER_SOURCE=2 DEV_PER_SOURCE=1 STEPS=2 EPOCHS=1 \
+PARALLEL=dp2 DEVICES=0,1 \
+  bash examples/decision/run_npu_parallel.sh
+
+PARALLEL=tp2 DEVICES=0,1 STEPS=2 \
+  bash examples/decision/run_npu_parallel.sh
+
+PARALLEL=cp2 DEVICES=0,1 STEPS=2 \
+  bash examples/decision/run_npu_parallel.sh
+
+PARALLEL=d4t2 DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 STEPS=2 \
+  bash examples/decision/run_npu_parallel.sh
+```
+
+`test_qwen35_decision_e2e.py::test_qwen35_decision_sft_multi_npu` runs the two-step
+`dp2`, `tp2`, and `cp2` layouts the same way as the single-NPU test: `decision_loss` is
+logged and `head.pt` is saved. It is marked `multi_npu` and `slow`.
+
+### Pipeline parallel
+
+Pipeline parallel does not train this head. Qwen3.5 ties the input embedding to the
+language-model head. The key issue is that Megatron's tied-embedding machinery assumes
+the output layer is a vocabulary projection, but PointerHead is a different kind of
+head. With pipeline size 1 the tie stays on one rank, which is why DP, TP, and CP work.
+With pipeline size greater than 1, rank 0 owns the embedding and the last rank owns
+`PointerHead`. Megatron still treats that head as the tied vocabulary matrix and reads
+`output_layer.weight` from it.
+
+Two of those reads showed up in the NPU runs:
+
+1. **Load.** `MegatronModelBridge._broadcast_shared_embeddings` sends the embedding to
+   the last stage. That stage has no embedding, so it builds the receive buffer with
+   `empty_like(output_layer.weight)`. `PointerHead` has `q` and `k` only, so initialize
+   raises `AttributeError`.
+1. **Forward and gradient sync.** `GPTModel.shared_embedding_or_output_weight` returns
+   `self.output_layer.weight` on the post-process stage, and `finalize_model_grads`
+   all-reduces that tensor with the stage-0 embedding gradient. The first training step
+   hits the same missing attribute.
+
+The load crash can be patched on its own. Before `_broadcast_shared_embeddings`, attach
+a temporary `vocab × hidden` parameter named `weight` on the `PointerHead` (dtype
+`params_dtype`, not the head's fp32 `q`/`k`). Let the broadcast copy the embedding into
+it, then delete the parameter before the optimizer is built. That gets past
+`initialize`. It does not make a step succeed: the temporary parameter is gone by the
+time the forward asks for `output_layer.weight` again. Leaving the matrix in place would
+also register a tied vocabulary parameter the decision loss never uses, and the gradient
+all-reduce would still expect it to be the shared embedding.
+
+Untying the embedding is a model-construction change. Stage 0 allocates that matrix as a
+shared weight (`skip_weight_param_allocation` on the output layer). A head-only patch
+cannot turn the tie off after the pipeline modules exist. `run_npu_parallel.sh` exits if
+the parsed pipeline size is greater than 1.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Write a small n_per_source slice of a decision suite to JSONL.
+
+Point ``--suite`` at any frozen suite directory (``manifest.json`` plus
+``train.jsonl`` / ``development.jsonl``) or a folder of those JSONL files.
+
+    python3 examples/decision/prepare_v7_sample.py \
+        --suite /data/decision \
+        --out-dir examples/decision/data \
+        --n-per-source 32 --dev-per-source 4
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+_REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(_REPO) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(_REPO))
+
+from areal.dataset.decision import (  # noqa: E402
+    load_labelled_path,
+    select_labelled_records,
+)
+
+
+def _write_jsonl(path: Path, records: list[dict]) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        for record in records:
+            handle.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
+
+
+def prepare_decision_sample(
+    suite: Path,
+    out_dir: Path,
+    n_per_source: int = 32,
+    dev_per_source: int = 4,
+    verify_suite: bool = False,
+) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
+    train = select_labelled_records(
+        load_labelled_path(suite, split="train", verify_suite=verify_suite),
+        n_per_source=n_per_source,
+    )
+    dev = select_labelled_records(
+        load_labelled_path(suite, split="development", verify_suite=verify_suite),
+        n_per_source=dev_per_source,
+    )
+    train_path = out_dir / "poc-train.jsonl"
+    dev_path = out_dir / "poc-dev.jsonl"
+    _write_jsonl(train_path, train)
+    _write_jsonl(dev_path, dev)
+    print(
+        f"wrote {len(train)} train records -> {train_path}\n"
+        f"wrote {len(dev)} development records -> {dev_path}"
+    )
+    return train_path, dev_path
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--suite",
+        type=Path,
+        required=True,
+        help="Decision suite directory or a folder containing train/development JSONL",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--out-dir",
+        type=Path,
+        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "data",
+        help="Directory for the sampled JSONL files",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--n-per-source", type=int, default=32)
+    parser.add_argument("--dev-per-source", type=int, default=4)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--verify-suite",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="Check suite checksums while sampling (slow, not needed for a PoC slice)",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    prepare_decision_sample(
+        suite=args.suite,
+        out_dir=args.out_dir,
+        n_per_source=args.n_per_source,
+        dev_per_source=args.dev_per_source,
+        verify_suite=args.verify_suite,
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# PointerHead decision SFT on one or more Ascend NPUs.
+#
+# Same recipe as examples/decision/qwen3_5_decision_sft_npu_poc.yaml
+# (LoRA 16, lr 5e-5, head_dim 256, max_state 384). PARALLEL picks the
+# Megatron layout. World size is DP * TP * PP * CP * EP and must match
+# the number of device ids in DEVICES.
+#
+# Layouts for Qwen3.5-4B-Base (32 layers, 16 query heads, 4 KV heads,
+# dense hybrid full-attention + Gated DeltaNet, no MoE experts):
+#
+#   PARALLEL   backend              NPUs   what it runs
+#   single     megatron:d1          1      data parallel 1
+#   dp2        megatron:d2          2      data parallel
+#   dp4        megatron:d4          4      data parallel
+#   tp2 / sp   megatron:d1t2        2      tensor parallel; sequence parallel on
+#   tp4        megatron:d1t4        4      tensor parallel; sequence parallel on
+#   cp2        megatron:d1c2        2      context parallel
+#   cp4        megatron:d1c4        4      context parallel
+#   pp2/pp4/vpp                     --      unsupported for PointerHead; see README
+#   d4t2       megatron:d4p1t2      8      template in qwen3_5_decision_sft.yaml
+#
+# Sequence parallel has no letter of its own. MegatronEngine enables it
+# whenever tensor parallel is greater than 1. Expert parallel (e) is for
+# MoE checkpoints; this 4B model has no experts, so e stays 1.
+# TP must divide the 4 KV heads, so 2 and 4 are the sizes to use.
+# PP and PP*VPP must divide the 32 layers.
+#
+#   MODEL_PATH=/path/to/Qwen3.5-4B-Base \
+#   SUITE_PATH=/path/to/decision-suite \
+#   N_PER_SOURCE=8 DEV_PER_SOURCE=2 \
+#   PARALLEL=single DEVICES=0 STEPS=24 EPOCHS=1 \
+#     bash examples/decision/run_npu_parallel.sh
+#
+#   PARALLEL=dp2 DEVICES=0,1 STEPS=2 \
+#     bash examples/decision/run_npu_parallel.sh
+#
+#   PARALLEL=tp2 DEVICES=0,1 STEPS=2 \
+#     bash examples/decision/run_npu_parallel.sh
+#
+#   PARALLEL=d4t2 DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 STEPS=2 \
+#     bash examples/decision/run_npu_parallel.sh
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+cd "$ROOT"
+
+export PYTHONPATH="${ROOT}${PYTHONPATH:+:${PYTHONPATH}}"
+export TORCH_COMPILE_DISABLE="${TORCH_COMPILE_DISABLE:-1}"
+# Worker health checks use http://<route-ip>:<port>. With HTTP_PROXY set, that
+# request leaves the node unless the route IP, hostname, and loopback are in
+# NO_PROXY. The rpc_server process inherits this environment.
+HOST_IPS="$(hostname -I 2>/dev/null | xargs | tr ' ' ',')"
+HOST_NAME="$(hostname -f 2>/dev/null || hostname 2>/dev/null || true)"
+ROUTE_IPS="$(python3 - <<'PY'
+import socket
+ips = []
+def add(ip):
+    if ip and ip not in ips:
+        ips.append(ip)
+try:
+    for family, _, _, _, sockaddr in socket.getaddrinfo(socket.gethostname(), None):
+        add(sockaddr[0])
+except OSError:
+    pass
+try:
+    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM) as sock:
+        sock.connect(("8.8.8.8", 80))
+        add(sock.getsockname()[0])
+except OSError:
+    pass
+print(",".join(ips))
+PY
+)"
+export NO_PROXY="${NO_PROXY:+${NO_PROXY},}127.0.0.1,localhost,::1${HOST_NAME:+,${HOST_NAME}}${HOST_IPS:+,${HOST_IPS}}${ROUTE_IPS:+,${ROUTE_IPS}}"
+export no_proxy="$NO_PROXY"
+
+MODEL_PATH="${MODEL_PATH:-}"
+SUITE_PATH="${SUITE_PATH:-}"
+DATA_PATH="${DATA_PATH:-}"
+TRAIN_PATH="${TRAIN_PATH:-}"
+VALID_PATH="${VALID_PATH:-}"
+FILEROOT="${FILEROOT:-/tmp/areal/experiments}"
+NAME_RESOLVE="${NAME_RESOLVE:-${FILEROOT}/name_resolve}"
+EPOCHS="${EPOCHS:-2}"
+STEPS="${STEPS:-}"
+SAVE_STEPS="${SAVE_STEPS:-}"
+EVAL_STEPS="${EVAL_STEPS:-}"
+N_PER_SOURCE="${N_PER_SOURCE:-32}"
+DEV_PER_SOURCE="${DEV_PER_SOURCE:-4}"
+BATCH="${BATCH:-4}"
+SLICE_DIR="${SLICE_DIR:-${ROOT}/examples/decision/data}"
+PARALLEL="${PARALLEL:-single}"
+DEVICES="${DEVICES:-}"
+MB_TOKENS="${MB_TOKENS:-}"
+VPP="${VPP:-}"
+
+if [[ -z "$MODEL_PATH" ]]; then
+  echo "Set MODEL_PATH to a local Qwen3.5 checkpoint or a Hugging Face repo id." >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+if [[ "$MODEL_PATH" == /* || "$MODEL_PATH" == .* ]] && [[ ! -e "$MODEL_PATH" ]]; then
+  echo "model path not found: $MODEL_PATH" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi

+case "$PARALLEL" in
+  single|d1) BACKEND="megatron:d1" ;;
+  dp|dp2) BACKEND="megatron:d2" ;;
+  dp4) BACKEND="megatron:d4" ;;
+  tp|tp2|sp|sp2) BACKEND="megatron:d1t2" ;;
+  tp4) BACKEND="megatron:d1t4" ;;
+  cp|cp2) BACKEND="megatron:d1c2" ;;
+  cp4) BACKEND="megatron:d1c4" ;;
+  pp|pp2) BACKEND="megatron:d1p2" ;;
+  pp4) BACKEND="megatron:d1p4" ;;
+  vpp) BACKEND="megatron:d1p2"; VPP="${VPP:-2}" ;;
+  d4t2|d4p1t2) BACKEND="megatron:d4p1t2" ;;
+  megatron:*) BACKEND="$PARALLEL" ;;
+  *)
+    echo "Unknown PARALLEL=${PARALLEL}." >&2
+    echo "Use single, dp2, dp4, tp2, tp4, cp2, cp4, pp2, pp4, vpp, d4t2," >&2
+    echo "or a megatron: backend string such as megatron:d2t2." >&2

+PARSED="$(python3 - "$BACKEND" <<'PY'
+import re
+import sys
+
+backend = sys.argv[1]
+spec = backend.split(":", 1)[1]
+if any(token in spec for token in ("attn", "ffn", "|")):
+    raise SystemExit(
+        "hybrid attn|ffn backends are for MoE folding; this recipe uses dense Qwen3.5-4B"
+    )

+for kind, raw in re.findall(r"([dtpce])([1-9][0-9]*)", spec):
+    sizes[kind] *= int(raw)
+world = 1
+for value in sizes.values():
+    world *= value
+print(world, sizes["d"], sizes["t"], sizes["p"], sizes["c"], sizes["e"])
+PY
+)"
+read -r WORLD DP TP PP CP EP <<< "$PARSED"
+
+if [[ "$EP" -gt 1 ]]; then
+  echo "Expert parallel (${EP}) does not apply to dense Qwen3.5-4B-Base." >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+if [[ "$TP" -gt 4 ]]; then
+  echo "Tensor parallel ${TP} does not divide Qwen3.5-4B's 4 KV heads." >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+if [[ "$VPP" == "" ]]; then
+  VPP=1
+fi
+if [[ "$VPP" -gt 1 && "$PP" -le 1 ]]; then
+  echo "Virtual pipeline parallel requires pipeline parallel greater than 1." >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+if (( 32 % (PP * VPP) != 0 )); then
+  echo "PP=${PP} VPP=${VPP} does not divide Qwen3.5-4B's 32 layers." >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+if [[ "$PP" -gt 1 ]]; then

+  echo "See examples/decision/README.md (Pipeline parallel)." >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+if [[ -z "$DEVICES" ]]; then

+fi
+IFS=',' read -ra DEVICE_IDS <<< "$DEVICES"
+if [[ "${#DEVICE_IDS[@]}" -ne "$WORLD" ]]; then
+  echo "${BACKEND} needs ${WORLD} NPUs; DEVICES=${DEVICES} has ${#DEVICE_IDS[@]}." >&2
+  exit 1
+fi

+fi
+if [[ "$PP" -gt 1 && -z "$MB_TOKENS" ]]; then

+fi

+SAFE_NAME="$(printf '%s' "$PARALLEL" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9' '-')"
+EXPERIMENT_NAME="${EXPERIMENT_NAME:-qwen35-decision-npu-${SAFE_NAME}}"
+TRIAL_NAME="${TRIAL_NAME:-${SAFE_NAME}}"
+
+if [[ -n "$TRAIN_PATH" ]]; then
+  if [[ ! -f "$TRAIN_PATH" || ! -f "${VALID_PATH:-}" ]]; then
+    echo "Set TRAIN_PATH and VALID_PATH to existing JSONL files." >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+elif [[ -n "$SUITE_PATH" ]]; then
+  if [[ ! -d "$SUITE_PATH" ]]; then
+    echo "decision suite not found: $SUITE_PATH" >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+  echo "Sampling ${N_PER_SOURCE} train / ${DEV_PER_SOURCE} dev records per source"
+  python3 examples/decision/prepare_v7_sample.py \
+    --suite "$SUITE_PATH" \
+    --out-dir "$SLICE_DIR" \
+    --n-per-source "$N_PER_SOURCE" \
+    --dev-per-source "$DEV_PER_SOURCE"
+  TRAIN_PATH="${SLICE_DIR}/poc-train.jsonl"
+  VALID_PATH="${SLICE_DIR}/poc-dev.jsonl"
+elif [[ -n "$DATA_PATH" ]]; then
+  if [[ -f "$DATA_PATH/train.jsonl" ]]; then
+    TRAIN_PATH="$DATA_PATH/train.jsonl"
+    if [[ -f "$DATA_PATH/development.jsonl" ]]; then
+      VALID_PATH="$DATA_PATH/development.jsonl"
+    elif [[ -f "$DATA_PATH/valid.jsonl" ]]; then
+      VALID_PATH="$DATA_PATH/valid.jsonl"
+    else
+      echo "${DATA_PATH} needs development.jsonl or valid.jsonl" >&2
+      exit 1
+    fi
+  elif [[ -f "$DATA_PATH/manifest.json" ]]; then
+    python3 examples/decision/prepare_v7_sample.py \
+      --suite "$DATA_PATH" \
+      --out-dir "$SLICE_DIR" \
+      --n-per-source "$N_PER_SOURCE" \
+      --dev-per-source "$DEV_PER_SOURCE"
+    TRAIN_PATH="${SLICE_DIR}/poc-train.jsonl"
+    VALID_PATH="${SLICE_DIR}/poc-dev.jsonl"
+  else
+    echo "${DATA_PATH} needs train.jsonl or manifest.json" >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+else
+  echo "Set SUITE_PATH, DATA_PATH, or TRAIN_PATH + VALID_PATH." >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+echo "PARALLEL=${PARALLEL} backend=${BACKEND} devices=${DEVICES} batch=${BATCH} dp=${DP} tp=${TP} pp=${PP} cp=${CP} vpp=${VPP}"
+if [[ "$TP" -gt 1 ]]; then
+  echo "Sequence parallel is enabled because tensor parallel is ${TP}."
+fi
+
+TRAIN_ARGS=(
+  --config examples/decision/qwen3_5_decision_sft_npu_poc.yaml
+  "experiment_name=${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
+  "trial_name=${TRIAL_NAME}"
+  "scheduler.type=local"
+  "cluster.n_nodes=1"
+  "cluster.n_gpus_per_node=${WORLD}"
+  "cluster.fileroot=${FILEROOT}"
+  "cluster.name_resolve.nfs_record_root=${NAME_RESOLVE}"
+  "actor.path=${MODEL_PATH}"
+  "tokenizer_path=${MODEL_PATH}"
+  "actor.backend=${BACKEND}"
+  "total_train_epochs=${EPOCHS}"
+  "train_dataset.batch_size=${BATCH}"
+  "valid_dataset.batch_size=${BATCH}"
+  "train_dataset.path=${TRAIN_PATH}"
+  "valid_dataset.path=${VALID_PATH}"
+)
+if [[ -n "$MB_TOKENS" ]]; then
+  TRAIN_ARGS+=("actor.mb_spec.max_tokens_per_mb=${MB_TOKENS}")
+fi
+if [[ "$VPP" -gt 1 ]]; then
+  TRAIN_ARGS+=("actor.megatron.virtual_pipeline_parallel_size=${VPP}")
+fi
+if [[ -n "$STEPS" ]]; then

+    "saver.freq_steps=${SAVE_STEPS:-$STEPS}"
+    "evaluator.freq_steps=${EVAL_STEPS:-$STEPS}"
+  )

+else
+  echo "Training ${EPOCHS} epochs"
+fi
+
+python3 examples/decision/train_decision.py "${TRAIN_ARGS[@]}"
+
+echo "Done. Logs: ${FILEROOT}/logs/${USER:-$(id -un)}/${EXPERIMENT_NAME}/${TRIAL_NAME}"
+echo "Checkpoints: ${FILEROOT}/checkpoints/${USER:-$(id -un)}/${EXPERIMENT_NAME}/${TRIAL_NAME}"

+#
+# Optional:
+#   VALID_PATH       development / validation JSONL
+#   FILEROOT         default /tmp/areal/experiments
+#   EPOCHS           default 2
+#   STEPS            optional step cap; unset means run the full epoch budget
+#   SAVE_STEPS       checkpoint interval when STEPS is set (default: STEPS)
+#   EVAL_STEPS       eval interval when STEPS is set (default: STEPS)
+#   N_PER_SOURCE     default 32 (only when sampling a suite)
+#   DEV_PER_SOURCE   default 4
+#   DEVICE           default 0  (ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES)
+#

+

+

+cd "$ROOT"
+
+export PYTHONPATH="${ROOT}${PYTHONPATH:+:${PYTHONPATH}}"
+export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${DEVICE:-${ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-0}}"
+export TORCH_COMPILE_DISABLE="${TORCH_COMPILE_DISABLE:-1}"
+# Local scheduler health-checks the node IP. If that address is missing from
+# NO_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY intercepts worker RPC and the run hangs.
+HOST_IPS="$(hostname -I 2>/dev/null | xargs | tr ' ' ',')"
+HOST_NAME="$(hostname -f 2>/dev/null || hostname 2>/dev/null || true)"
+ROUTE_IPS="$(python3 - <<'PY'
+import socket
+ips = []

+    for family, _, _, _, sockaddr in socket.getaddrinfo(socket.gethostname(), None):
+        add(sockaddr[0])
+except OSError:
+    pass
+try:
+    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM) as sock:
+        sock.connect(("8.8.8.8", 80))
+        add(sock.getsockname()[0])
+except OSError:
+    pass
+print(",".join(ips))
+PY
+)"
+export NO_PROXY="${NO_PROXY:+${NO_PROXY},}127.0.0.1,localhost,::1${HOST_NAME:+,${HOST_NAME}}${HOST_IPS:+,${HOST_IPS}}${ROUTE_IPS:+,${ROUTE_IPS}}"
+export no_proxy="$NO_PROXY"
+
+MODEL_PATH="${MODEL_PATH:-}"

+    TRAIN_PATH="${SLICE_DIR}/poc-train.jsonl"
+    VALID_PATH="${SLICE_DIR}/poc-dev.jsonl"
+  else
+    echo "${DATA_PATH} needs train.jsonl or manifest.json" >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+else
+  echo "Set SUITE_PATH, DATA_PATH, or TRAIN_PATH + VALID_PATH to your local decision data." >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+TRAIN_ARGS=(
+  --config examples/decision/qwen3_5_decision_sft_npu_poc.yaml
+  "experiment_name=${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"

+  "total_train_epochs=${EPOCHS}"

+if [[ -n "${STEPS}" ]]; then
+  TRAIN_ARGS+=(
+    "total_train_steps=${STEPS}"
+    "saver.freq_steps=${SAVE_STEPS:-$STEPS}"

+  )
+  echo "Training up to ${STEPS} steps, ${EPOCHS} epoch cap, NPU ${ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES}"
+else
+  echo "Training ${EPOCHS} epochs on NPU ${ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES} from ${MODEL_PATH}"
+fi
+python3 examples/decision/train_decision.py "${TRAIN_ARGS[@]}"
+
+echo "Done. Logs: ${FILEROOT}/logs/${USER:-$(id -un)}/${EXPERIMENT_NAME}/${TRIAL_NAME}"
+echo "Checkpoints: ${FILEROOT}/checkpoints/${USER:-$(id -un)}/${EXPERIMENT_NAME}/${TRIAL_NAME}"

+"""Qwen3.5 PointerHead decision SFT entrypoint.
+
+Single-NPU PoC:
+
+    MODEL_PATH=/path/to/Qwen3.5-4B-Base \
+    SUITE_PATH=/path/to/decision-suite \
+      bash examples/decision/run_npu_poc.sh
+
+Or, from the repo root:
+
+    python3 examples/decision/train_decision.py \
+        --config examples/decision/qwen3_5_decision_sft_npu_poc.yaml \
+        actor.path=/path/to/Qwen3.5-4B-Base \
+        train_dataset.path=/path/to/train.jsonl \
+        valid_dataset.path=/path/to/development.jsonl
+"""
+
+import sys
+
+from areal import SFTTrainer
+from areal.api.cli_args import SFTConfig, load_expr_config
+from areal.dataset import get_custom_dataset
+from areal.utils.hf_utils import load_hf_tokenizer
+
+
+def main(args):
+    config, _ = load_expr_config(args, SFTConfig)
+
+    tokenizer = load_hf_tokenizer(config.tokenizer_path)
+
+    train_dataset = get_custom_dataset(
+        dataset_config=config.train_dataset,
+        tokenizer=tokenizer,
+    )
+    valid_dataset = None
+    if config.valid_dataset is not None:
+        valid_dataset = get_custom_dataset(
+            dataset_config=config.valid_dataset,
+            tokenizer=tokenizer,
+        )
+
+    with SFTTrainer(
+        config, train_dataset=train_dataset, valid_dataset=valid_dataset
+    ) as trainer:
+        trainer.train()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main(sys.argv[1:])

+def _ensure_module(monkeypatch, name: str) -> ModuleType:
+    parts = name.split(".")
+    for i in range(1, len(parts) + 1):
+        qual = ".".join(parts[:i])
+        if qual not in sys.modules:
+            monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, qual, ModuleType(qual))
+        if i > 1:
+            parent = sys.modules[".".join(parts[: i - 1])]
+            child = parts[i - 1]
+            if getattr(parent, child, None) is not sys.modules[qual]:
+                monkeypatch.setattr(parent, child, sys.modules[qual], raising=False)
+    return sys.modules[name]

+def _hybrid_lora_classes(monkeypatch):
+    """Make the three patch() imports succeed; return the classes it will bind."""
+    try:
+        from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.layers import (
+            ColumnParallelLinear,
+            RowParallelLinear,
+        )
+    except ImportError:
+        layers = _ensure_module(monkeypatch, "megatron.core.tensor_parallel.layers")
+        monkeypatch.setattr(
+            layers, "ColumnParallelLinear", type("ColumnParallelLinear", (), {})
+        )
+        monkeypatch.setattr(
+            layers, "RowParallelLinear", type("RowParallelLinear", (), {})
+        )
+        from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.layers import (
+            ColumnParallelLinear,
+            RowParallelLinear,
+        )
+
+    try:
+        from mindspeed.core.megatron_basic.megatron_basic import PTNorm
+    except ImportError:
+        basic = _ensure_module(

+        )
+        monkeypatch.setattr(basic, "PTNorm", type("PTNorm", (), {}))
+        from mindspeed.core.megatron_basic.megatron_basic import PTNorm

+    try:
+        from megatron.bridge.models.qwen_vl import qwen35_vl_provider
+    except ImportError:
+        pkg = _ensure_module(monkeypatch, "megatron.bridge.models.qwen_vl")
+        provider = _ensure_module(

+        ):

+        from megatron.bridge.models.qwen_vl import qwen35_vl_provider

+def _layer(kind: str):
+    if kind == "full":
+        attn = SimpleNamespace(
+            metainfo={"fuse_input_layernorm": True},
+            submodules=SimpleNamespace(linear_qkv=_Fused, linear_proj=_Fused),
+        )
+    else:
+        attn = SimpleNamespace(
+            metainfo={"fuse_input_layernorm": True},
+            submodules=SimpleNamespace(in_proj=_Fused, out_proj=_Fused),
+        )
+    mlp = SimpleNamespace(
+        metainfo={"fuse_pre_mlp_layernorm": True},
+        submodules=SimpleNamespace(linear_fc1=_Fused, linear_fc2=_Fused),
+    )
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        submodules=SimpleNamespace(
+            self_attention=attn,
+            mlp=mlp,
+            input_layernorm=_Fused,
+            pre_mlp_layernorm=_Fused,
+        )
+    )

+def _hybrid_block():

+def _patched_block(monkeypatch, *, unfuse_gdn: bool):

+        lambda *a, **k: _hybrid_block(),
+    )
+    patch_qwen35_hybrid_lora_specs(unfuse_gdn=unfuse_gdn)
+    block = provider.get_transformer_block_with_experimental_attention_variant_spec()

+    assert full.submodules.mlp.submodules.linear_fc1 is col

+    assert gdn.submodules.input_layernorm is norm
+    assert gdn.submodules.self_attention.submodules.in_proj is col

+    assert gdn.submodules.self_attention.metainfo["fuse_input_layernorm"] is False

+def test_pointer_head_forward_shape_and_grad():
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    head = PointerHead(8, dp=4)
+    hidden = torch.randn(5, 3, 8, dtype=torch.bfloat16, requires_grad=True)
+    projected, extra = head(hidden)
+    assert extra is None
+    assert projected.shape == (5, 3, 8)
+    assert projected.dtype == torch.float32
+    assert projected.reshape(-1, 8).shape == (15, 2 * 4)
+    projected.sum().backward()

+    assert head.k.weight.grad is not None

+def test_pointer_head_scores_are_scaled_dots():
+    torch.manual_seed(1)
+    head = PointerHead(8, dp=4)
+    decide = torch.randn(8)
+    options = torch.randn(6, 8)

+    k_one = head.k(options)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        head.score_single(q_one, k_one),

+    head.eval()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        head.score_single(q_one, k_one),

+def _proj_from_logits(z: torch.Tensor, dp: int = 8) -> torch.Tensor:
+    scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(dp)
+    q_all = torch.zeros(z.numel() + 1, dp)
+    k_all = torch.zeros(z.numel() + 1, dp)
+    q_all[-1, 0] = 1.0
+    k_all[:-1, 0] = z.float() / scale
+    return torch.cat([q_all, k_all], dim=-1)
+
+
+def _pack_question(z, label, qtype, soft=None, dp=8):
+    k = z.numel()
+    roles = torch.tensor([ROLE_OPT] * k + [ROLE_DECIDE])
+    choice = torch.full((k + 1,), -1)
+    choice[-1] = label
+    qtypes = torch.full((k + 1,), -1)
+    qtypes[-1] = qtype
+    if soft is None:
+        target = torch.full((k + 1,), -1.0)
+    else:
+        target = torch.tensor(list(soft) + [-1.0], dtype=torch.float32)
+    return _proj_from_logits(z, dp), {
+        "cu_seqlens": torch.tensor([0, k + 1], dtype=torch.int32),
+        "token_roles": roles,
+        "choice_label": choice,
+        "question_type": qtypes,
+        "soft_target": target,
+    }
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "qtype,opts",

+        (_CHOICE, {"label_smoothing": 0.05}),

+        (_CHOICE, {"focal_gamma": 1.0}),
+        (_SCORE, {}),

+)
+def test_question_loss_matches_definitions(qtype, opts):
+    z = torch.tensor([0.4, -0.7, 1.2])
+    y = torch.tensor([1])
+    expected = F.cross_entropy(
+        z[None], y, label_smoothing=opts.get("label_smoothing", 0.0)
+    )
+    if opts.get("brier_w"):
+        target = F.one_hot(y[0], 3).float()
+        expected = expected + opts["brier_w"] * (z.softmax(-1) - target).square().sum()
+    if opts.get("focal_gamma"):
+        expected = (1 - torch.exp(-expected)).pow(opts["focal_gamma"]) * expected
+    if qtype == _SCORE:
+        p = z.softmax(-1)
+        observed = (torch.arange(2) >= 1).to(p.dtype)
+        expected = expected + 0.5 * (p.cumsum(-1)[:-1] - observed).square().mean()
+    actual = question_loss(z, 1, qtype, None, 0.5, **opts)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected)

+def test_soft_target_and_packed_loss_match_definitions():
+    z = torch.tensor([2.0, 0.0, -2.0])
+    t = torch.tensor([1 / 3, 1 / 3, 1 / 3])
+    expected = -(t * F.log_softmax(z, -1)).sum()
+    actual = question_loss(z, 0, _CHOICE, t, 0.0, brier_w=0.5)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected)
+
+    proj, input_ = _pack_question(z, 0, _CHOICE, soft=t.tolist())
+    tracker = DistributedStatsTracker()
+    with patch("areal.trainer.sft.decision.stats_tracker", tracker):
+        packed = compute_packed_decision_loss(proj, input_, brier_w=0.5)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(packed, expected)

+def test_packed_loss_decreases_on_synthetic_step():
+    z = torch.tensor([0.1, 0.0, -0.2])
+    proj, input_ = _pack_question(z, 0, _CHOICE)
+    proj = proj.clone().requires_grad_(True)
+    opt = torch.optim.SGD([proj], lr=0.5)
+    tracker = DistributedStatsTracker()
+    losses = []
+    for _ in range(8):
+        opt.zero_grad()
+        with patch("areal.trainer.sft.decision.stats_tracker", tracker):
+            loss = compute_packed_decision_loss(proj, input_)
+        losses.append(float(loss.detach()))
+        loss.backward()
+        opt.step()
+        tracker.export(reset=True)
+    assert losses[-1] < losses[0]
+    expected = F.cross_entropy(z[None], torch.tensor([0]))
+    with patch("areal.trainer.sft.decision.stats_tracker", tracker):
+        first = compute_packed_decision_loss(_proj_from_logits(z), input_)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(first, expected)

+def _proj_from_logits(z: torch.Tensor, dp: int = 8) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Build ``[K + 1, 2 * dp]`` states whose PointerHead scores recover ``z``."""
+    k = z.numel()
+    scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(dp)
+    q_all = torch.zeros(k + 1, dp, dtype=torch.float32)
+    k_all = torch.zeros(k + 1, dp, dtype=torch.float32)
+    q_all[-1, 0] = 1.0
+    k_all[:-1, 0] = z.float() / scale
+    return torch.cat([q_all, k_all], dim=-1)

+def _split_packed(
+    tensor: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+    cp_rank: int,
+    cp_size: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    extra = tensor.shape[1:]
+    input_lens = cu_seqlens[1:] - cu_seqlens[:-1]
+    output_len = int(input_lens.sum().item()) // cp_size
+    splitted = tensor.new_zeros((output_len, *extra))
+    for i in range(input_lens.shape[0]):
+        seqlen = int(input_lens[i].item()) // cp_size
+        half = seqlen // 2
+        start = int(cu_seqlens[i].item()) // cp_size
+        row = tensor[cu_seqlens[i] : cu_seqlens[i + 1]]
+        splitted[start : start + half] = row[half * cp_rank : half * (cp_rank + 1)]
+        remain_start = int(input_lens[i].item()) - half * (cp_rank + 1)
+        remain_end = min(int(input_lens[i].item()) - half * cp_rank, row.shape[0])
+        remain = remain_end - remain_start
+        splitted[start + half : start + half + remain] = row[remain_start:remain_end]
+    return splitted

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Two-NPU checks for PointerHead context-parallel reassembly and replica sync.
+
+Launched by ``tests/test_qwen35_decision_npu.py``. Cases:
+
+* CP=2: all-gather 2-D PointerHead projections, unpad, packed decision loss
+* TP=2: broadcast / load ``head.pt`` so last-stage replicas match
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+import os
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from megatron.core import parallel_state as mpu
+from megatron.core.models.gpt.gpt_model import GPTModel
+from torch import nn
+
+from areal.dataset.decision import ROLE_DECIDE, ROLE_OPT
+from areal.engine.megatron_utils.packed_context_parallel import (
+    reassemble_cp_packed_logprobs,
+)
+from areal.infra.platforms import current_platform
+from areal.models.mcore.qwen35_decision import (
+    DecisionHeadMeta,
+    _agree_flag,
+    load_decision_pointer_head,
+    replace_output_layer_with_pointer_head,
+    save_decision_pointer_head,
+)
+from areal.trainer.sft.decision import compute_packed_decision_loss, question_loss
+from areal.utils.data import unpad_logits
+from areal.utils.stats_tracker import DistributedStatsTracker
+
+
+class _Stage(GPTModel):
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        nn.Module.__init__(self)
+        self.post_process = True
+        self.vocab_size = 16
+        self.output_layer = nn.Linear(8, 16, bias=False)
+
+
+def _device() -> torch.device:
+    return torch.device(current_platform.device_type, dist.get_rank())
+
+
+def _split_packed(
+    tensor: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+    cp_rank: int,
+    cp_size: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Interleaved CP split that keeps trailing feature dims."""
+    extra = tensor.shape[1:]
+    input_lens = cu_seqlens[1:] - cu_seqlens[:-1]
+    output_len = int(input_lens.sum().item()) // cp_size
+    splitted = tensor.new_zeros((output_len, *extra))
+    for i in range(input_lens.shape[0]):
+        seqlen = int(input_lens[i].item()) // cp_size
+        half = seqlen // 2
+        start = int(cu_seqlens[i].item()) // cp_size
+        row = tensor[cu_seqlens[i] : cu_seqlens[i + 1]]
+        splitted[start : start + half] = row[half * cp_rank : half * (cp_rank + 1)]
+        remain_start = seqlen * cp_size - half * (cp_rank + 1)
+        remain_end = min(seqlen * cp_size - half * cp_rank, row.shape[0])
+        remain = remain_end - remain_start
+        splitted[start + half : start + half + remain] = row[remain_start:remain_end]
+    return splitted
+
+
+def _place_scores(
+    proj: torch.Tensor,
+    opt_idx: list[int],
+    decide_idx: int,
+    scores: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    dp = proj.shape[-1] // 2
+    scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(dp)
+    proj[decide_idx, 0] = 1.0
+    proj[opt_idx, dp] = scores.to(dtype=proj.dtype) / scale
+
+
+def run_cp_reassemble_and_loss() -> None:
+    """Decide / option tokens sit on different CP ranks after the interleaved split."""
+    rank = dist.get_rank()
+    device = _device()
+    cp_size = mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size()
+    if cp_size != 2:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"expected CP=2, got {cp_size}")
+
+    # Two aligned rows. Seq0=16, seq1=8. Dummy tail of 8 is later unpadded.
+    # Seq0 opts 3,7 / decide 15; seq1 opts 2,5 / decide 7.
+    old_cu = torch.tensor([0, 16, 24], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    padded_cu = torch.tensor([0, 16, 24, 32], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    padding_length = 8
+    dp = 4
+    proj = torch.zeros(32, 2 * dp, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    z0 = torch.tensor([0.4, -0.7], dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    z1 = torch.tensor([1.2, 0.3], dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    _place_scores(proj, [3, 7], 15, z0)
+    _place_scores(proj, [18, 21], 23, z1)
+
+    roles = torch.zeros(24, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
+    roles[[3, 7, 18, 21]] = ROLE_OPT
+    roles[[15, 23]] = ROLE_DECIDE
+    labels = torch.full((24,), -1, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
+    labels[15] = 1
+    labels[23] = 0
+    qtypes = torch.full((24,), -1, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
+    qtypes[[15, 23]] = 0
+    soft = torch.full((24,), -1.0, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    orig = {
+        "cu_seqlens": old_cu,
+        "token_roles": roles,
+        "choice_label": labels,
+        "question_type": qtypes,
+        "soft_target": soft,
+    }
+
+    local = _split_packed(proj, padded_cu, rank, cp_size).detach().requires_grad_(True)
+    reassembled = reassemble_cp_packed_logprobs(local, padded_cu)
+    unpadded = unpad_logits(reassembled, padding_length, padded_cu, old_cu)
+    if tuple(unpadded.shape) != (24, 2 * dp):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"rank {rank}: unpadded shape {tuple(unpadded.shape)}")
+
+    tracker = DistributedStatsTracker()
+    with patch("areal.trainer.sft.decision.stats_tracker", tracker):
+        loss = compute_packed_decision_loss(unpadded, orig)
+    expected = torch.stack(
+        [
+            question_loss(z0, 1, 0, None, 0.0),
+            question_loss(z1, 0, 0, None, 0.0),
+        ]
+    ).mean()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(loss, expected, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-5)
+
+    loss.backward()
+    if local.grad is None or not torch.isfinite(local.grad).all():
+        raise RuntimeError(f"rank {rank}: CP decision loss gradient is invalid")
+    # Each local token maps to exactly one global token. The dummy tail (24:32)
+    # is dropped by unpad, so those CP shards must receive zero gradient.
+    dummy_local = _split_packed(
+        torch.arange(32, device=device), padded_cu, rank, cp_size
+    )
+    dummy_mask = dummy_local >= 24
+    if local.grad[dummy_mask].abs().sum() != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"rank {rank}: dummy CP shard received a gradient")
+
+    dist.barrier()
+    if rank == 0:
+        print("PASS decision CP reassemble + packed loss", flush=True)
+
+
+def run_head_broadcast_and_checkpoint(weights_path: str) -> None:
+    rank = dist.get_rank()
+    device = _device()
+    torch.manual_seed(10 + rank)
+    stage = _Stage()
+    stage.output_layer = stage.output_layer.to(device)
+    head = replace_output_layer_with_pointer_head(
+        stage,
+        SimpleNamespace(hidden_size=8, sequence_parallel=True),
+        head_dim=4,
+    )
+    if head is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"rank {rank}: PointerHead was not attached")
+    head.temperature = 1.25 + rank
+
+    missing = os.path.join(weights_path, "missing")
+    os.makedirs(missing, exist_ok=True)
+    load_decision_pointer_head(stage, missing)
+    gathered = [torch.empty_like(head.q.weight) for _ in range(dist.get_world_size())]
+    dist.all_gather(gathered, head.q.weight.detach())
+    for replica in gathered[1:]:
+        torch.testing.assert_close(replica, gathered[0])
+    temps = [torch.tensor([head.temperature], device=device) for _ in range(2)]
+    dist.all_gather(temps, torch.tensor([head.temperature], device=device))
+    if temps[0].item() != temps[1].item():
+        raise RuntimeError(f"temperature replicas diverged: {temps}")
+
+    if mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank() == 0:
+        head.q.weight.data.fill_(0.37)
+        head.k.bias.data.fill_(-0.2)
+        head.temperature = 2.5
+    path = save_decision_pointer_head(
+        stage,
+        weights_path,
+        meta=DecisionHeadMeta(
+            base="Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B",
+            weights="full",
+            lora=0,
+            temperature=2.5,
+        ),
+    )
+    if rank == 0 and path is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("checkpoint writer did not write head.pt")
+    dist.barrier()
+
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        head.q.weight.fill_(float(rank + 1))
+        head.k.bias.fill_(float(rank + 3))
+        head.temperature = 9.0
+    meta = load_decision_pointer_head(stage, weights_path)
+    if meta is None or meta.weights != "full":
+        raise RuntimeError(f"rank {rank}: failed to reload head.pt")
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        head.q.weight, torch.full_like(head.q.weight, 0.37), rtol=0, atol=0
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        head.k.bias, torch.full_like(head.k.bias, -0.2), rtol=0, atol=0
+    )
+    if head.temperature != 2.5:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"rank {rank}: temperature {head.temperature}")
+
+    dist.barrier()
+    if rank == 0:
+        print("PASS decision head broadcast + head.pt", flush=True)
+
+
+def run_agree_flag() -> None:
+    device = _device()
+    local = dist.get_rank() == 0
+    agreed = _agree_flag(local, device)
+    if agreed:
+        raise RuntimeError("disagreeing ranks must take the missing-checkpoint branch")
+    if not _agree_flag(True, device):
+        raise RuntimeError("unanimous True must stay True")
+    dist.barrier()
+    if dist.get_rank() == 0:
+        print("PASS decision agree-flag", flush=True)
+
+
+def _init_mp(*, tensor_parallel: int = 1, context_parallel: int = 1) -> None:
+    if mpu.model_parallel_is_initialized():
+        mpu.destroy_model_parallel()
+    mpu.initialize_model_parallel(
+        tensor_model_parallel_size=tensor_parallel,
+        context_parallel_size=context_parallel,
+    )
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    local_rank = int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"])
+    current_platform.set_device(local_rank)
+    dist.init_process_group(backend=current_platform.communication_backend)
+    weights_path = os.environ.get("DECISION_TEST_TMP")
+    if not weights_path:
+        raise RuntimeError("DECISION_TEST_TMP must point at a shared temp directory")
+    try:
+        _init_mp(context_parallel=2)
+        run_cp_reassemble_and_loss()
+        _init_mp(tensor_parallel=2)
+        run_head_broadcast_and_checkpoint(weights_path)
+        run_agree_flag()
+    finally:
+        if mpu.model_parallel_is_initialized():
+            mpu.destroy_model_parallel()
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Two-NPU check that PointerHead gathers the sequence and splits its gradient."""
+
+import os
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from megatron.core import parallel_state as mpu
+
+from areal.infra.platforms import current_platform
+from areal.models.mcore.qwen35_decision import PointerHead
+
+
+def _broadcast_parameters(module: torch.nn.Module, src: int = 0) -> None:
+    for param in module.parameters():
+        dist.broadcast(param.data, src=src)
+
+
+def run() -> None:
+    rank = dist.get_rank()
+    world = dist.get_world_size()
+    if world != 2:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"expected 2 ranks, got {world}")
+    device = torch.device(current_platform.device_type, rank)
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+
+    head = PointerHead(8, dp=4, config=SimpleNamespace(sequence_parallel=True)).to(
+        device
+    )
+    _broadcast_parameters(head)
+
+    full = torch.randn(4, 2, 8, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+    dist.broadcast(full, src=0)
+    local = full.chunk(world, dim=0)[rank]
+
+    projected, extra = head(local)
+    if extra is not None or projected.shape != (4, 2, 8):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"rank {rank}: gathered projection shape {tuple(projected.shape)}"
+        )
+    if projected.dtype != torch.float32 or projected.device.type != "npu":
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"rank {rank}: projection is {projected.dtype} on {projected.device}"
+        )
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        reference = torch.cat([head.q(full.float()), head.k(full.float())], dim=-1)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(projected, reference)
+
+    projected.sum().backward()
+    local_grad = head.q.weight.grad.detach().clone()
+
+    reference_head = PointerHead(8, dp=4).to(device)
+    reference_head.load_state_dict(
+        {key: value.detach().clone() for key, value in head.state_dict().items()}
+    )
+    reference_out, _ = reference_head(full.detach())
+    reference_out.sum().backward()
+
+    for param in head.parameters():
+        dist.all_reduce(param.grad)
+    for name, param in head.named_parameters():
+        torch.testing.assert_close(param.grad, reference_head.get_parameter(name).grad)
+
+    # Each rank owns a different sequence shard, so the pre-allreduce gradient
+    # is only that shard's contribution.
+    if torch.equal(local_grad, head.q.weight.grad):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"rank {rank}: sequence-parallel gradient was not split")
+
+    dist.barrier()
+    if rank == 0:
+        print("PASS pointer-head sequence-parallel gather", flush=True)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    local_rank = int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"])
+    current_platform.set_device(local_rank)
+    dist.init_process_group(backend=current_platform.communication_backend)
+    mpu.initialize_model_parallel(tensor_model_parallel_size=2)
+    try:
+        run()
+    finally:
+        mpu.destroy_model_parallel()
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
